name: Invoice Intake & Approval - ClickUp Statuses + Email Buttons for upload

parameters.formDescription: Drop a PDF invoice. It is read by AI, validated, filed in ClickUp and reviewed by email.

nodes.name: Upload Form
nodes.notes: Browser upload form served by n8n itself

nodes.name: Prepare PDF
nodes.notes: json.file_name + binary.data

nodes.name: Extract PDF Text
nodes.notes: PDF -> plain text (no OCR)

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: ALL settings. The 5 status names must match your ClickUp list EXACTLY.

nodes.name: LLM Extract Fields
nodes.notes: OpenAI-compatible chat call, JSON mode, temperature 0

nodes.name: Parse & Validate
nodes.notes: Parses AI JSON, checks the maths, applies the limit

nodes.name: Build ClickUp Task
nodes.notes: Task title + markdown description

nodes.name: Create ClickUp Task
nodes.notes: Task is born in 'Submitted' - it exists even if the workflow later fails

nodes.name: Re-attach PDF
nodes.notes: Puts the original PDF back on the item

nodes.name: Attach PDF to Task
nodes.notes: Non-fatal: a failed upload never stops the pipeline

nodes.name: Task Context
nodes.notes: One item with invoice fields + task id/url for everything downstream

nodes.name: Needs Approval?
nodes.notes: true = flagged or over limit -> human. false = auto-approve.

nodes.name: Move to Reviewing
nodes.notes: Task shows 'Reviewing' while the email is out

assignments.name: comment_text
assignments.value: ={{ 'Auto-approved by the workflow: all validation checks passed and the total is under the limit of ' + $('Config').first().json.auto_approve_limit + '.' }}

nodes.name: Mark Auto-Approved
nodes.notes: Clean + under the limit: straight to Approved

nodes.name: Final Decision
nodes.notes: Both paths meet here (human decision or auto-approval)

nodes.name: Update ClickUp Status
nodes.notes: Moves the task to its final status

nodes.name: Add ClickUp Comment
nodes.notes: Decision + reviewer comment saved on the task = audit trail

parameters.subject: ={{ ({ APPROVED: '✅ Approved', AUTO_APPROVED: '🤖 Auto-approved', CHANGES_NEEDED: '✏️ Changes needed', REJECTED: '❌ Rejected', EXPIRED: '⏰ Still waiting' }[$('Final Decision').first().json.decision] || 'ℹ️ Processed') + ': ' + $('Final Decision').first().json.invoice_number + ' | ' + $('Final Decision').first().json.vendor }}
parameters.message:
={{ 'Invoice ' + $('Final Decision').first().json.invoice_number + ' from ' + $('Final Decision').first().json.vendor + ' (' + $('Final Decision').first().json.currency + ' ' + $('Final Decision').first().json.total + ') is now "' + $('Final Decision').first().json.target_status + '" in ClickUp.'
  + ($('Final Decision').first().json.reviewer_comment ? '

Comment: ' + $('Final Decision').first().json.reviewer_comment : '')
  + ($('Final Decision').first().json.attach_ok ? '' : '

Note: the PDF could not be attached to the task.')
  + '

Task: ' + $('Final Decision').first().json.task_url }}

nodes.name: Notify Outcome
nodes.notes: Summary email with the task link

parameters.content:
## ① Intake
### Upload a PDF. Prepare PDF normalises it.

## ② AI extraction
### PDF text -> LLM in JSON mode (temperature 0) -> structured fields. Provider is one node - swappable.

## ③ Validate + file as SUBMITTED
### Checks the maths and the limit, then creates the ClickUp task and attaches the PDF. The task exists from this point on.

nodes.name: Note: ③ Validate + file as SUBMITTED

parameters.content:
## ④ Human review by email buttons
### Task -> REVIEWING. The email has three buttons; each one calls this execution's private resume URL, so the workflow pauses until you click. The browser then shows a confirmation page. Clean invoices under the limit skip this and are auto-approved.

nodes.name: Note: ④ Human review by email

parameters.content:
## ⑤ Sync + notify
### Move the task to its final status, post the decision as a comment, email a summary.

nodes.name: Review Link
nodes.notes: Captures this execution's private resume URL - the buttons call it

nodes.name: Build Review Email
nodes.notes: HTML email: details + three buttons (Approve / Request changes / Reject)

nodes.name: Email Review Request
nodes.notes: Sends the review email

nodes.name: Wait for Review Click
nodes.notes: PAUSES until a button is clicked or the time limit passes (then: EXPIRED). The browser gets the page_html built by the last node.

nodes.name: Decision from Link
nodes.notes: approve / changes / reject -> matching ClickUp status. No click -> EXPIRED (stays Reviewing)

nodes.name: Thanks Page
nodes.notes: Builds the confirmation page the browser shows (Wait node returns this node's page_html)
